why.title: Scenarios are hard to recreate and teams are hard to gather — how do you train for real response?
why.description: Mobile training trailers and instructor series props bring leak, plug, reaction, and decon scenarios to your teams without requiring a permanent large-scale site.
why.lead: For agencies running cross-region or cross-unit drills, enclosed mobile trailers deploy complete hazmat scenes anywhere — flip-up side doors and a rear ramp simplify setup, built-in equipment bays centralize electrical controls, and one operator can manage the entire scene.

propsSection.title: Hazmat training scenarios
propsSection.description: Controllable, repeatable, combinable hazard props covering leak response, plugging, chemical reaction, and uncontrolled release scenarios.

props.title: Chlorine cylinder
props.desc: Full-size chlorine cylinder with controllable valve, pipe, and manifold leaks for locating, plugging, and valve shutoff training.

props.title: Leaking drum
props.desc: Standard drum simulating forklift puncture, bung, or seam leaks for transfer, containment, and cover response.

props.title: Bulk tank leak
props.desc: Contain and respond to flammable liquid leaks including valve, manifold, and tank rupture scenarios.

props.title: Reaction drum
props.desc: In-drum chemical reaction with bubbling, gurgling, and vibration; bulging drum top signals rising pressure for risk assessment training.

props.title: Falling cylinder
props.desc: Rack failure causing uncontrolled release of cylinders and manifolds — realistic field response challenges.

props.title: Control panel
props.desc: Handheld tablet to manage all props with emergency stop, pause, and reset for training control and personnel safety.

trailer.title: Bring the training ground to your teams
trailer.description: For agencies organizing cross-region or cross-unit training, mobile trailers deploy complete hazmat scenarios so teams at different locations train in a unified, realistic environment.
features: Enclosed trailer with multiple flip-up side doors and rear ramp
Built-in equipment bay with front-end prop operation and electrical controls
Standard hazmat props included (chlorine cylinders, leaking drums, reaction drums, etc.)
Wireless portable control — one operator manages the entire scene
Full LED lighting, non-slip steel flooring, and floor drains
Customizable exterior graphics and color scheme
